summary: AstroGuard is a health monitoring system developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to help monitor astronauts' health during space missions. The project aims to address the challenges of tracking astronauts' health in an environment where access to medical assistance is limited. By using sensor-based measurements and scientific data from NASA, AstroGuard monitors essential health indicators and presents the collected information through an interactive interface. The application includes real-time data visualization, charts, an alarm system to detect unusual measurements, and a data logging feature to track changes over time. By combining continuous health monitoring, data analysis, and early warning capabilities, AstroGuard aims to support astronaut safety, improve health risk awareness, and contribute to the development of safer future space missions.
details:
AstroGuard is an innovative astronaut health monitoring system developed by Team SEXTANS for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Its main purpose is to support astronaut safety by continuously monitoring important health indicators during space missions, where access to medical assistance can be limited.

The system combines an ESP32-based sensor infrastructure with a digital monitoring application. Sensor measurements are collected and transferred to the application, where health data can be monitored and analyzed. The application includes a dashboard, graphical data visualization, an alarm system for unusual measurements, and a data logging feature that allows previous measurements to be reviewed. NASA's scientific data and research are also used as references to support the project's approach to astronaut health monitoring.

AstroGuard aims to make health monitoring more accessible, organized, and effective by bringing hardware and software together in one system. It can help identify unusual changes in health indicators and provide early warnings, supporting faster awareness of potential health risks.

The project was developed using programming, sensor integration, data visualization, and interface design. Our team focused on combining scientific research, technological innovation, and practical problem-solving. What makes AstroGuard creative is its integrated approach: instead of treating health measurements as separate pieces of information, it brings monitoring, analysis, alerts, and historical data together in a single platform. Our long-term goal is to contribute to safer and more sustainable human space exploration.
